```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here, fixest, TwoWayFEWeights)

data <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly.parquet"))
```

## Table E.1, Panel A

```{r}
twfe <- feols(
  n_installations_per_1000 ~ treatment | MunicipalityCode + date,
  data    = data,
  cluster = ~MunicipalityCode
)
twfe
```

## Table E.1, Panels B and C

```{r}
twowayfeweights(
  data,
  "n_installations_per_1000", "MunicipalityCode", "date", "treatment",
  type             = "feTR",
  summary_measures = TRUE
)
```

## TWFE event study and its decomposition

```{r}
data <- data |>
  group_by(MunicipalityCode) |>
  mutate(Fg = min(time[treatment == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
         Fg = ifelse(is.infinite(Fg), NA, Fg)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    rel_time       = time - (Fg - 1),
    rel_time1      = replace_na(as.integer(rel_time == 1), 0L),
    rel_time2      = replace_na(as.integer(rel_time == 2), 0L),
    rel_time3      = replace_na(as.integer(rel_time == 3), 0L),
    rel_timeminus1 = replace_na(as.integer(rel_time == -1), 0L),
    rel_timeminus2 = replace_na(as.integer(rel_time == -2), 0L),
    rel_timeminus3 = replace_na(as.integer(rel_time == -3), 0L)
  )

twfe_es <- feols(
  n_installations_per_1000 ~ rel_timeminus3 + rel_timeminus2 + rel_timeminus1 +
    rel_time1 + rel_time2 + rel_time3 | MunicipalityCode + date,
  data    = data,
  cluster = ~MunicipalityCode
)
twfe_es

twowayfeweights(
  data,
  Y                = "n_installations_per_1000",
  G                = "MunicipalityCode",
  T                = "time",
  D                = "rel_time1",
  type             = "feTR",
  other_treatments = c("rel_time2", "rel_time3"),
  controls         = c("rel_timeminus1", "rel_timeminus2", "rel_timeminus3")
)

twowayfeweights(
  data,
  Y                = "n_installations_per_1000",
  G                = "MunicipalityCode",
  T                = "time",
  D                = "rel_time2",
  type             = "feTR",
  other_treatments = c("rel_time1", "rel_time3"),
  controls         = c("rel_timeminus1", "rel_timeminus2", "rel_timeminus3")
)

twowayfeweights(
  data,
  Y                = "n_installations_per_1000",
  G                = "MunicipalityCode",
  T                = "time",
  D                = "rel_time3",
  type             = "feTR",
  other_treatments = c("rel_time1", "rel_time2"),
  controls         = c("rel_timeminus1", "rel_timeminus2", "rel_timeminus3")
)
```

## TWFE event study with all relative periods and its decomposition

```{r}
rel_values <- sort(setdiff(unique(data$rel_time), c(0, NA)))
rel_name <- function(r) if (r > 0) paste0("rel_time", r) else paste0("rel_timeminus", -r)
for (r in rel_values) {
  data[[rel_name(r)]] <- replace_na(as.integer(data$rel_time == r), 0L)
}
lags  <- sapply(rel_values[rel_values > 0], rel_name)
leads <- sapply(rel_values[rel_values < 0], rel_name)

twfe_es_all <- feols(
  as.formula(paste("n_installations_per_1000 ~",
                   paste(c(leads, lags), collapse = " + "),
                   "| MunicipalityCode + date")),
  data    = data,
  cluster = ~MunicipalityCode
)
twfe_es_all

twowayfeweights(
  data,
  Y                = "n_installations_per_1000",
  G                = "MunicipalityCode",
  T                = "time",
  D                = "rel_time1",
  type             = "feTR",
  other_treatments = setdiff(lags, "rel_time1"),
  controls         = leads
)

twowayfeweights(
  data,
  Y                = "n_installations_per_1000",
  G                = "MunicipalityCode",
  T                = "time",
  D                = "rel_time2",
  type             = "feTR",
  other_treatments = setdiff(lags, "rel_time2"),
  controls         = leads
)

twowayfeweights(
  data,
  Y                = "n_installations_per_1000",
  G                = "MunicipalityCode",
  T                = "time",
  D                = "rel_time3",
  type             = "feTR",
  other_treatments = setdiff(lags, "rel_time3"),
  controls         = leads
)
```
